_help: One line per meeting, kept in date order. date is YYYY-MM-DD. type is TALK, WORK, SPECIAL or BREAK (BREAK = no meeting that week; the home page skips it). The hackathon is NOT in this file: it lives in site.json and appears on the calendar automatically. Optional keys: time (HH:MM), room.
